title: Microsoft Purview: permanently delete OneDrive and SharePoint files with Priority cleanup
summary: Hold: the policy-creation path skips the wizard choices that select the scope type and the SharePoint/OneDrive policy. The licensing list, rollout targets, default state and audit command are supported. Minor corrections are also needed to complete two control paths and align the checklist and risk rating with the standard.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: The policy-creation path goes directly from + Create a priority cleanup to Choose what to do with the content without the scope-type and workload-policy choices.
claims.quote: For Choose the type of priority cleanup, select Adaptive or Static then select Next. ... For Static scope, select Policy for SharePoint/OneDrive
claims.fix: Give a complete static-policy route in controls[0].ui.path and the first table row: 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Priority cleanup > + Create a priority cleanup > Choose the type of priority cleanup > Static > Policy for SharePoint/OneDrive > Choose what to do with the content > Delete data permanently'. The scope-type and workload choices are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/priority-cleanup-onedrive-sharepoint; the permanent-deletion page documents the final option. Keep the existing docs URL for that final option.
